issue.title: vault-sync loops forever when a conflicted .bob/stats journal's _conflicts/ copy is gitignored
issue.description:
## What happens

Since 2026-10-15 05:39 EDT, athena's `bob-vault-sync` watcher has been failing every ~20 s.
Each cycle hits a both-modified conflict on `.bob/stats/review/2026-10.kellys-macbook-pro.jsonl`
(plus `bob.md` and `cash.md`). `resolve_conflicts` (src/native/vault_sync.rs) writes the
local stage to `_conflicts/.bob/stats/review/<stem>.athena-<ts>.jsonl` via
`conflict_copy_path`, which mirrors the original's parent directories under `_conflicts/`.
The vault `.gitignore` starts with `*` and only unignores the root-anchored
`!/.bob/stats/**/*.jsonl`, so that mirrored path stays ignored. `git_add_path` then fails with
"The following paths are ignored by one of your .gitignore files". The cycle errors out, the
next cycle reports `interrupted_merge_recovered: true`, and the whole thing repeats.

## Evidence (athena, 2026-10-15 ~15:25)

- `bob vault-sync status --json`: `last_success_at` 05:38:35, and `last_attempt_at` keeps advancing.
  `last_error` reads "git failed: The following paths are ignored by one of your .gitignore files:
  _conflicts/.bob/stats/review/2026-10.kellys-macbook-pro.athena-2026-10-15T152400-0400.jsonl".
- `journalctl --user -u bob-vault-sync.service` logs the same error first at 05:39:31, then every ~20 s.
- `git check-ignore -v _conflicts/.bob/stats/review/x.jsonl` matches `.gitignore:3:*`.
- `~/bob/_conflicts/` now holds about 3,300 files: 1,642 `bob.athena-*.md`, 1,642 `cash.athena-*.md`,
  and about 1,659 `_conflicts/.bob/stats/review/*.jsonl`.
- `.git/MERGE_HEAD` exists, and `git status` shows `UU bob.md` / `UU cash.md`.

## Likely fix direction

Conflict copies have to be addable, whatever the vault's allowlist says. Two candidates:
use `git add -f` for paths this code generates under `_conflicts/`, or flatten or escape
dot-directories in `conflict_copy_path`. Separately, append-only per-host journals under
`.bob/stats/**` probably should not take the quarantine path at all. A `merge=union`
gitattribute, or keeping the remote copy and re-appending local lines, avoids the conflict.
Add a regression test that runs a conflicted `.bob/stats/...jsonl` through `resolve_conflicts`
against an allowlist-style `.gitignore`.

Cleanup of the accumulated `_conflicts/` copies and the stuck athena merge is a separate,
user-gated operational step. Do not bulk-delete the quarantined copies without Bryan.

task_type_fields.impact: athena's vault sync is wedged mid-merge (UU bob.md, cash.md) and quarantines bob.md/cash.md copies every cycle (~3,300 files in _conflicts/ in 10 hours); athena-side edits (bob nightly, task archive) cannot sync
task_type_fields.location: src/native/vault_sync.rs resolve_conflicts / conflict_copy_path / git_add_path; vault .gitignore root-anchored !/.bob/stats/**/*.jsonl

issue.creation_reason: Found while researching the sase_blog merge: athena's vault-sync has failed every ~20s since 05:39 today and has piled up ~3,300 conflict copies, so athena receives no vault changes.

payload.description: Same resolve_conflicts path: run_notify fires on each conflict cycle, so this loop also re-triggers that notification bug every ~20s
Confirm the athena vault-sync bug cited as a precondition for the sase_blog merge
This lock race is the trigger that feeds bob-cli-81's ignored-conflict-copy loop; fixing either one stops the Oct 15/19 pattern

evidence.note: Independent recurrence on athena, 2026-10-19 12:06:47–12:27:18 EDT: 60 cycles, each conflicting on .bob/stats/review/2026-10.kellys-mbp.jsonl and sase.md and failing with the same 'paths are ignored' error on _conflicts/.bob/stats/review/...jsonl. It left 60 identical sase.md copies (all equal to Mac commit 18c22602) and ended only when someone made a merge commit by hand at 12:27:18. The Oct 15 loop ran ~1,822 cycles (05:39–16:23) until a manual reset to origin/master. Tested on today's exact case: merge=union on .bob/stats/**/*.jsonl merges local 'A B' against remote 'A B C' cleanly to 'A B C'. Also suggest a circuit breaker: stop and notify once when the same origin SHA forces a second interrupted-merge abort. The trigger (half-applied fast-forward caused by git 2.47's detached auto-gc holding HEAD.lock) is filed separately as bob-cli-9w.
